title: July 2025 DOJ/FBI Memo: No 'Client List'
summary: Unsigned two-page DOJ/FBI memo after systematic review: (1) no incriminating 'client list' found; (2) no credible evidence Epstein blackmailed prominent individuals; (3) suicide finding reaffirmed (medical examiner + 2023 DOJ OIG report); (4) no further disclosures warranted at that time. AG Bondi had said in Feb 2025 a 'client list' was 'sitting on my desk'; she walked that back July 8. No document functioning as a client list has ever been entered as an exhibit in any Epstein/Maxwell case.

sources.label: DOJ/FBI memorandum on Epstein investigative holdings, July 2025 — official PDF

tldr: After reviewing 300+ GB of Epstein files, the DOJ and FBI found no 'client list,' no credible evidence of blackmail, and no basis to investigate uncharged third parties — and reaffirmed Epstein died by suicide.

- Suicide reaffirmed: SHU video shows nobody entered Epstein's tier between ~10:40 pm Aug 9 and ~6:30 am Aug 10, 2019; consistent with the 2019 autopsy and 2023 DOJ Inspector General findings.
- Determination: no further disclosure warranted. Record summary verified accurate against the document.
